summary_hint: AVM home-value estimate for <property_address> (<property_type>): <estimated_value> (range <value_range_low>-<value_range_high>). NOT an appraisal.

typed_core.name: property_address
typed_core.why: identity — which property the estimate is for; match to the subject property

typed_core.name: property_type
typed_core.why: processor — the property description (Single Family Detached, condo, etc.), as stated

typed_core.name: bedrooms
typed_core.why: processor — a basic property fact the estimate is based on
typed_core.prompt_hint: Capture 0 faithfully if the estimate states 0 (the AVM's own data)

typed_core.name: bathrooms
typed_core.why: processor — a basic property fact (may be fractional, e.g. 2.5)

typed_core.name: square_feet
typed_core.why: processor — living area the estimate is based on

typed_core.name: estimated_value
typed_core.why: processor — the single point AVM value. NOTE: this is a NON-BINDING estimate, NOT an appraised value; capture the number, do not treat it as evidence of value

typed_core.name: value_range_low
typed_core.why: processor — the low end of the estimate's value range
typed_core.prompt_hint: The low end of 'Range: L to H'

typed_core.name: value_range_high
typed_core.why: processor — the high end of the estimate's value range
typed_core.prompt_hint: The high end of 'Range: L to H'

typed_core.name: annual_property_taxes
typed_core.why: processor — the annual property taxes the tool reports for the property

typed_core.name: disclaimer_text
typed_core.why: processor — the tool's own disclaimer; the printed proof this is NOT an appraisal ('do not constitute an appraisal; should not be relied upon in lieu of an appraisal'). Capturing it keeps the not-an-appraisal fact attached to the value
typed_core.prompt_hint: The '*Estimated property values are...' disclaimer, verbatim if present

rejected.name: appraised_value / value_conclusion / opinion_of_value
rejected.reason: an AVM is NOT an appraisal and produces NO appraised value or opinion of value. Naming a field 'appraised_value' would invite wiring the estimate into a property rule as certified value — the exact error the type name and disclaimer exist to prevent. Tags describe; rules judge.

rejected.name: comparable_sales
rejected.reason: an AVM is not a comparable-grid appraisal; no comps are printed on the estimate. That is appraisal territory (the appraisal type).

rejected.name: estimate_date
rejected.reason: NOT printed on either sample capture (070, 197). Drop rather than invent (LP-461). Re-add if a full HVE PDF report with a date appears.

rejected.name: provider_name / avm_vendor
rejected.reason: NOT printed — the captures are the lender portal's own 'Home Value Estimator' with no named third-party AVM vendor. Drop; re-add if a vendor-attributed report appears.

rejected.name: confidence_score / forecast_standard_deviation
rejected.reason: no numeric confidence/FSD is printed — only the disclaimer text (captured as disclaimer_text).

encoding_variations: the estimate is often a screenshot of a lender-portal 'Home Value Estimator' tool (with or without the tool's tab bar); the value block is the substance
bedrooms may legitimately be 0 (the AVM's own data), e.g. 197 shows '0 Bedroom' — capture it faithfully, do not treat 0 as absent
the value range prints as 'Range: $L to $H'; the point value as '*Estimated Value $V'
the disclaimer ('do not constitute an appraisal') is always present on these tools and is the key not-an-appraisal signal

open_questions.q: Keep provider_name / estimate_date as optional despite being absent on the two samples?
options: keep optional for full HVE PDF reports
open_questions.recommendation: drop (GEET'S DECISION, LP-466): neither is printed on 070 or 197; re-add when a full HVE PDF report sample shows them

notes: No PII: every number is < 9 digits (value, range, taxes, sq ft), so nothing trips the LP-209 at-rest guard; home_value_estimate has zero _PII_FIELDS entries.

No rule reads this type (rules_served empty) — an AVM is deliberately NOT evidence of value for underwriting. It earns a catalog type on processor visibility + to anchor the dashboard/AVM routing pair (ADR-465's rule; see ADR for LP-466).
The whole design intent is captured by the type NAME and disclaimer_text: this is an estimate, not an appraisal.
